purpose: Produce one selector that uniquely identifies a target from observed semantic candidate properties.
trigger: Use when one selection predicate is ambiguous or selected the wrong candidate.

inputs.name: failed_selection_predicate
inputs.description: One existing selector, its failure/ambiguity, and consuming source location.

inputs.name: actual_candidate_properties
inputs.description: Candidate geometry/state properties available for discrimination.

inputs.name: target_semantics
inputs.description: Target direction, position, normal, area, bounds, topology, adjacency, or type.

preconditions: At least one wrong/ambiguous selection and observable candidate properties exist.
Target semantics are explicit enough for a stable predicate.

outputs.name: corrected_selector
outputs.description: One copyable selector expression using semantic fields.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when properties do not make one target unique.

postconditions: The emitted selector contains semantic predicates and a uniqueness assertion for one target; selection execution is not claimed.
No selector uses ordinal aliases, list order, or Boolean return order.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. One selector repair only; it does not execute selection or mutate geometry.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Evaluate against current candidates; after topology mutation, re-enumerate before selection.

failure_modes.condition: Predicate selects zero or multiple candidates.

recovery.action: Add one evidence-backed criterion or return needs_manual_review.
Rewrite with semantic properties and uniqueness check.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
